title: Srimanikandan Ramamoorthy – Senior Director, Finance
description: Meet Srimanikandan Ramamoorthy (Mani), Senior Director – Finance at Ameratech.ai, overseeing financial operations, strategy, and business growth initiatives.
body:
# Srimanikandan Ramamoorthy (Mani)

Senior Director - Finance

Mani is a senior finance, cost and operations leader with 30 plus years of experience in Information Technology (IT) Services organisation with special focus on Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Pricing, creation of a Profit & Loss Management Culture, Due Diligence, Enterprise Monetization, Core Accounting, Real Estate creation and Facilities operation.

Mani is a certified Cost and Management Accountant (CMA)
